When the context is excessively long, the model's recall and logical rigor for information in the middle sections decline, making it prone to "hallucinations."

items.title: OneCLI – Vault for AI Agents in Rust
items.raw_excerpt:
We built OneCLI because AI agents are being given raw API keys. And it's going about as well as you'd expect. We figured the answer isn't "don't give agents access," it's "give them access without giving them secrets." OneCLI is an open-source gateway that sits between your AI agents and the services they call. You store your real credentials once in OneCLI's encrypted vault, and give your agents placeholder keys. When an agent makes an HTTP call through the proxy, OneCLI matches the request by host/path, verifies the agent should have access, swaps the placeholder for the real credential, and forwards the request. The agent never touches the actual secret. It just uses CLI or MCP tools as normal. Try it in one line:
docker run --pull always -p 10254:10254 -p 10255:10255 -v onecli-data:/ap

title_i18n.zh: OneCLI – 专为AI代理设计的Rust语言保险库
title_i18n.es: OneCLI – Caja fuerte para agentes de IA en Rust

When an agent makes an HTTP call through the proxy, OneCLI matches the request by host/path, verifies the agent should have access, swaps the placeholder for the real credential, and forwards the request. excerpt_i18n.en: Just the day before yesterday, ByteDance's Doubao team officially announced that Doubao is launching a mobile assistant. The Doubao Mobile Assistant is an AI assistant developed by ByteDance in collaboration with smartphone manufacturers, implemented through operating system-level authorization. Backed by the internationally leading Doubao large model, which excels in reasoning, vision, image and video creation, voice, and other areas, the Doubao Mobile Assistant brings users key innovations in interaction and experience. Is the Doubao Mobile Assistant a prelude to ByteDance entering the smartphone business? Doubao officials have given a clear denial: Doubao has no plans to develop its own smartphones. Currently, the Doubao Mobile Assistant integrates software technology into devices of different brands through ecosystem partnerships, and Doubao is in talks with multiple smartphone manufacturers. Today, the smartphone model open for experiencing the Doubao Mobile Assistant is the engineering prototype nubia M153, a collaboration between ByteDance and ZTE. This phone has also been released in limited quantities to developers and tech enthusiasts, allowing them to experience the technical preview version of the Doubao Mobile Assistant, priced at 3,499 yuan. Do not underestimate Doubao's "transformation" this time—the mobile assistant holds significant implications for the productization of large models. The most direct change is that using the Doubao Mobile Assistant has become simpler and more convenient for users. First, users are now "closer" to Doubao. With voice commands, the "AI button" on the side of the phone, or the Doubao OlaFriend earphones, users can directly summon Doubao to answer questions or even initiate AI voice calls. With user authorization, the AI can even directly recognize the content on the phone screen, making interactions more straightforward.
excerpt_i18n.es: Justo anteayer, el equipo de Doubao de ByteDance anunció oficialmente: Doubao se convertirá en asistente de móvil. Doubao Asistente de Móvil es un asistente de IA desarrollado por ByteDance en colaboración con fabricantes de teléfonos, implementado a nivel del sistema operativo con autorización correspondiente. Respaldado por el avanzado modelo Doubao, líder internacional en razonamiento, visión, creación de imágenes y videos, voz y más, Doubao Asistente de Móvil ofrece a los usuarios innovaciones clave en interacción y experiencia. ¿Es Doubao Asistente de Móvil el preludio de ByteDance en el negocio de móviles? Doubao ha dado una negativa clara: no tienen planes de desarrollar su propio teléfono. Actualmente, Doubao Asistente de Móvil integra tecnología de software en modelos de diferentes marcas mediante colaboraciones ecológicas, y Doubao está en conversaciones con varios fabricantes de móviles.

On March 12, the Ezviz Stella Series Technology Launch commenced at the Ezviz booth at AWE Shanghai New International Expo Center. Under the theme "Steam Evolution, AI New Clean Frontier," the event unveiled the Stella Series AI Steam Mopping Robot. Leveraging the world's first dual-engine, dual-heat live water mopping solution and the self-developed Ezviz Stella World Model, Ezviz achieved dual breakthroughs in cleaning capability and AI technology, leading the cleaning industry into the 6.0 era and injecting disruptive innovation into the cleaning market.

Industry challenges highlight how the Ezviz Stella Series directly addresses user pain points. The floor-cleaning robot industry has undergone multiple generations of technological evolution, yet core user cleaning issues remain unresolved. According to widely recognized technical analysis, the 1.0 to 3.0 eras were in a primitive stage of "dirty mopping with dirt," plagued by weak cleaning power and noticeable water stains. The 4.0 era's room-temperature live water mopping mode struggled with mixed dry and wet debris.
